variables.title: Variables
variables.code:
x := 10 // inferred type
y: int = 20 // explicit type
variables.notes: Variables are declared using := for inference or : type = for explicit typing.

data_types.title: Data Types
data_types.code:
a: int = 1
b: f32 = 2.0
c: bool = true
d: string = "hello"
data_types.notes: Odin has standard primitive types like int, f32/f64, bool, and string.

operators.title: Operators
operators.code:
z := x + y
b := x > y
operators.notes: Standard arithmetic and logical operators are available.

conditionals.title: Conditionals
conditionals.notes: If statements do not require parentheses around the condition.

for_loop.title: For Loop
for_loop.notes: Standard C-style for loop without parentheses.

while_loop.title: While Loop
while_loop.notes: Odin uses the `for` keyword for while loops as well.

functions.title: Functions
functions.notes: Functions are declared with the `:: proc` syntax.

arrays.title: Arrays
arrays.notes: Arrays have a fixed size determined at compile time.

maps.title: Maps
maps.notes: Maps are built-in and created using `make`.

error_handling.title: Error Handling
error_handling.notes: Errors are typically returned as a second value.

comments.title: Comments & Documentation
comments.notes: Odin uses C-style // single-line and /* */ multi-line comments.

numbers.title: Numbers & Numerics
numbers.notes: Odin provides explicitly sized integer and floating-point primitives with binary and hex support.

booleans.title: Booleans & Conditions
booleans.notes: Odin uses bool / boolean types with true and false literals and logical operators (&&, ||, !).

type_casting.title: Type Casting & Conversion
type_casting.notes: Odin supports explicit type casting using cast operators or constructor functions.

strings.title: Strings & Characters
strings.notes: Odin distinguishes between single-character literals and string sequences or pointer slices.

string_formatting.title: String Formatting
string_formatting.notes: Odin supports string interpolation or printf-style formatting specifiers.

pattern_matching.title: Pattern Matching & Switch
pattern_matching.notes: Odin evaluates branching conditions through switch statements, match expressions, or when constructs.

range.title: Ranges & Slicing
range.notes: Odin represents ranges with range operators (.., ..<) or standard indexed iteration boundaries.

iterators.title: Iterators & Sequences
iterators.notes: Odin implements iteration through Iterator interfaces, generators, or range-for loops.

oop_classes.title: Classes & OOP
oop_classes.notes: Odin models object orientation through classes with constructors/encapsulation or structs with associated methods.

lists.title: Dynamic Arrays & Lists
lists.notes: Odin manages growable dynamic collections using vectors, ArrayLists, or dynamically reallocated heap buffers.

tuples.title: Tuples & Records
tuples.notes: Odin represents heterogeneous records through tuples, structured bindings, or lightweight record structs.

sets.title: Sets & Unique Collections
sets.notes: Odin provides unique collection hashing structures with O(1) average lookup and insertion time.

modules_import.title: Modules, Packages & Imports
modules_import.notes: Odin structures namespaces and external libraries via include directives, package declarations, or module imports.
